description.value: Café Artigiano is a pioneering BC specialty coffee chain with over 25 years of history, known for expertly crafted espresso drinks using in-house roasted 100% Arabica beans from their Burnaby roastery. This Langley location is part of a network of 25 cafes across BC and Alberta, each serving artisanal baked goods made from organic, local ingredients free of artificial additives. Some locations now operate as Cafe-Bars offering cocktails and Italian bites into the evening.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 53m; rack (3 spaces) at 63m; rack (5 spaces) at 69m; rack (3 spaces) at 79m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Artigiano is an active chain with a Langley location listed among its BC locations, consistent with the OSM address at 20020 84 Ave. The corporate website (caffeartigiano.com) does not provide location-specific amenity details such as bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi for individual cafes, so most amenity fields must be null. The 'Order Ahead' and 'ORDER ONLINE' features on the website confirm takeout capability; no other cyclist-specific amenities are evidenced.
concerns: OSM name is 'Café Artigiano' but current brand identity on the website is 'Artigiano' (domain: caffeartigiano.com) — minor name drift worth monitoring.
The corporate website does not publish individual location phone numbers, so the OSM phone (+1 672-968-4588) could not be verified.
OSM address lacks postal code and does not explicitly state city; inferred as Langley based on community tag and location coordinates.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active chain cafe with a confirmed Langley location listed on the corporate website; open and publicly accessible to touring cyclists.
